parsed.name: HP 6624A四路可编程直流电源
parsed.name_en: HP 6624A Four-Output Programmable DC Power Supply
parsed.description: HP 6624A 是一台四路可编程直流电源，可独立设置各输出通道的电压和电流，并测量实际输出电压与电流。它常用于实验室为电子电路、器件样品和多路测试系统提供稳定直流供电与偏置。
parsed.description_en: The HP 6624A is a four-output programmable DC power supply that can independently set voltage and current for each output channel and measure the actual output voltage and current. It is commonly used in laboratories to provide stable DC power and biasing for electronic circuits, device samples, and multi-rail test setups.
